summary: Third-hand 911 report of an injured climber who took a serious fall in the Lower Lost Man / Turkey Rock boulderfield along Hwy 82. MRA and Pitkin County Sheriff deployed but found no one in distress; the caller located the climber, who admitted falling but reported 0/0 pain and declined aid. Companion admitted blowing the report out of proportion.
location: Lower Lost Man / Turkey Rock area along State Highway 82
notes: False/third-hand report; indexed per unfounded-report precedent (id 2565, outcome=assist). Likely unfounded report (subject declined aid; companion admitted exaggeration); cf. id 2565 precedent for unfounded reports.
